name: song_28_factorized_source_oof_temperature_exploratory
source_data: Hashed Song HDF5 v3, one participant/day, native 250 Hz eight-channel EMG and 112 Hz IMU; causal filtering
branches: Previously fixed F0v2+F2a+F3c four-hand branch and 13-coordinate real-IMU F6 seven-arm branch; balanced logistic C=1, source-only StandardScaler, random_state=20260924
fold_fit_boundary: Every feature-family state, scaler and classifier is refit on just the training source session; held-out source session supplies trial probabilities and labels only. Full source S01+S02 models are refit separately for S03/S04 evaluation.
calibration_unit: Mean window class probability per native formal trial; temperature softmax(log(clipped trial probability)/T) applied separately to hand and arm branches before normalized outer product.
selection: Minimize pooled source-session OOF trial log loss separately for hand and arm; ties choose T closest to 1, then smaller T. No S03/S04 probability or label fits either temperature.
primary: S03 and S04 joint trial log loss and Brier; report macro-F1/accuracy and branch accuracy without claiming an unseen final set
scope: S03 collection readiness failed and S04 was already inspected; one person/day. This is source-only probability calibration evidence, not live reliability, force labels or cross-day transfer.
